title: DRIVE: a saturation on each track
description: A master page (FUNC + LFO) that gives the active audio track a drive of its own before its filter: TAPE, TUBE, FUZZ or FOLD, with amount, tone, mix and level; the page draws the curve and lists the eight tracks' drives. Saved. 0.4: the page's code is built smaller; the sound is unchanged.
author: Cere, made with Claude
